tool_input.description: Run report against test DB and inspect stdout bytes

result:
Scheduled publishing is implemented; `bunx guren gate` passes all six stages (codegen, typecheck, lint, check, audit, test), including 26 new tests in `tests/ScheduledPosts.test.ts`.

## Decisions to check

- **Leaving `publishAt` out of an update publishes the post.** This follows the contract ("absent or `null` means publish now") on `PUT` as well as `POST`. The edit form always sends the loaded date back, but any other client that omits the field will publish a scheduled post.
- **Someone else's scheduled post answers 404 on edit, update and delete**, not 403, so its existence is not revealed. Public posts still answer 403 to non-authors.
- **The home page shows public posts only, even to the author.** It has no "scheduled" marker, so a scheduled post listed there would look live.
- **An empty string for `publishAt` is rejected (422).** Only absent or `null` means "publish now"; the forms send `null` when the field is left empty.
- **A date without a time zone is rejected.** `2026-10-01T09:00` fails validation; the forms convert the browser's local time to UTC before sending.
- **Visibility compares `published_at` as text.** The app always stores the `toISOString()` UTC form, so anything that writes the column directly must use the same form or ordering breaks.

## One change outside the feature

`bin/console.ts` now sends `console.info` and `console.log` to stderr while the app boots. Without this, the framework's "Applied N migration(s)" notice landed on stdout the first time the report ran after a deploy. I confirmed against a fresh database that stdout stays empty and the notice goes to stderr.

## Not verified

The pages were typechecked but not opened in a browser, so the "Publish at" field and the "Scheduled · goes live …" notice are untested visually.

## Summary

I added a nullable `published_at` text column (`db/schema.ts`, migration `db/migrations/20260929184414_add_published_at_to_posts/`) and put the visibility rule in one place, `Post.visibleTo(viewerId)` in `app/Models/Post.ts`, alongside `Post.scheduled()` for the report. `PostController` uses that filter for the list, search, show, edit, update and delete, and `HomeController` uses it with guest visibility. `PostValidator.ts` accepts the optional `publishAt` field, and `PostResource.ts` exposes `publishedAt`. The `posts:scheduled` command lives in `app/Console/Commands/PostsScheduledCommand.ts` and is registered in `src/console.ts`. On the front end, `resources/js/components/PublishAt.tsx` provides the "Publish at" field and the scheduled notice, used by the `New`, `Edit`, `Index` and `Show` pages under `resources/js/pages/posts/`. The decisions are recorded in `docs/adr/0002-scheduled-posts-are-hidden-by-a-read-time-filter.md`, and the `.guren/*.gen.ts` manifests were regenerated. Nothing is committed.
